question.text: Krishna Infra Debt AIF (Cat II) is appointing an independent valuer for the quarterly NAV computation of unlisted portfolio companies. As per the chapter, an independent valuer for AIF must have:

answer.text: A minimum of 3 years of experience in valuation of unlisted securities, with valuations computed in the manner specified by SEBI.
A minimum of 10 years of experience as a merchant banker.
An RBI Category-I Authorised Dealer licence.
A SEBI Research Analyst certification under Regulation 12 of the RA Regulations.

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook states that AIF managers appoint independent valuers to compute valuations in the SEBI-specified manner, and that the valuer should have a minimum of 3 years of experience in valuing unlisted securities. Later valuation sections elaborate the independent registered valuer eligibility criteria. The Trap: Option B pushes the role to merchant banking. Option C confuses valuer eligibility with AD-bank licensing. Option D is a research-analyst certification, which is unrelated to asset valuation. Note: Two anchors apply — minimum 3 years' experience in unlisted-securities valuation and valuation in the manner specified by SEBI.
